title: scripts/experiments/waves-chart.go is not gofmt-clean
description:
A genuinely small, mechanically verifiable defect, chosen as the payload for the factory's end-to-end acceptance run (project w1z, A1).

`gofmt -l scripts/` reports `scripts/experiments/waves-chart.go`. The diff is one line of comment alignment:

  -	bg := color.RGBA{30, 30, 46, 255}      // catppuccin base
  +	bg := color.RGBA{30, 30, 46, 255}       // catppuccin base

gofmt aligns the trailing comments of a run of consecutive lines; the following line's comment sits one column further right, so this one is under-padded.

It is pre-existing on main and predates the cloud factory epics — the repo's gates only ever ran `gofmt -l cmd/ internal/`, so `scripts/` was never covered.

Work:
1. Run `gofmt -w scripts/experiments/waves-chart.go`.
2. Decide whether the gate should cover `scripts/` too, and say so in the report. If yes, widen it — a formatting rule nothing enforces is a rule that drifts back, which is the same class as the Go/TS parity gaps this project has now hit three times. If no, say why `scripts/` is deliberately exempt.

Deliberately trivial. The thing under test is the factory, not the work — that is what this epic is for.
acceptance_criteria: gofmt -l scripts/ is empty; go build ./... and go test ./... stay green; the report states whether the gate now covers scripts/ and why.
